tagline: The real Stockfish engine, running on your device — no internet needed.
description:
The real chess engine — Stockfish 18 — running on this device. Not a simplified stand-in: it does not need the network.

Pick your level from about 1320 up through Grandmaster, plus a top rung with no handicap at all — stronger than any human alive. Every search can show the engine's win / draw / loss odds and the best line it has found. Turn the coaching off if you just want to play.

Hints only ever appear when you press Hint. Take-backs, resign and a promotion picker are all there. Finished games are saved so you can step through any of them move by move, and your game in progress auto-saves — close the tab, come back, resume.

Or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices.
